$comment: Single source of truth for the Alert Dialog API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Asks the user to confirm before something that can't be undone, like deleting.
thumb:
Delete project?

You can't undo it.

Delete

cancel.description: The cancel button's text. It has focus when the dialog opens.

icon.description: A warning icon beside the title.
icon.html: svg.vin-alert-dialog__icon as the header's first child

open / defaultOpen.description: Use onOpenChange to hear about changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: Confirm a delete. In HTML both buttons submit a form[method=dialog]; read the answer from dialog.returnValue.

examples.title: With an icon
examples.description: A warning icon beside the title.

examples.title: Discard changes
examples.description: A softer question: the confirm button isn't red (variant="default").

a11y: role="alertdialog" tells screen readers it needs an answer; the title and description are read out when it opens.
Focus starts on the safe answer (autofocus), so Enter never deletes by accident.
There's no close button and a click outside doesn't close it. Escape cancels.
Say what will happen in the button text ("Delete project", not "OK").
